specific_early_forecast_risks.topic: clip2 has no demonstrated incremental seven-metric gain at768
specific_early_forecast_risks.text: At768 clip2 passes primary new_control gates and R=0.911863, but the unchanged joint-loss anchor has R=0.880956. Direct clip2/anchor R=1.032075 and R_attr=0.999612: speed improves10.66%, length/width worsen4.73%/5.81%, near/lat/angle worsen9.68%/2.51%/9.22%. Passing a baseline gate is not evidence of improving the chosen anchor.

specific_early_forecast_risks.topic: lower LR progress is slower, not a final-convergence proof
specific_early_forecast_risks.text: lr2e4 at768 has speed0.805819 versus anchor0.377798 (ratio2.132935), failing the speed gate versus both anchors. It does improve width16.76% versus the joint anchor and length is nearly unchanged. Its primary R declines1.616084→1.209673→1.112425 from256→512→768, and speed absolute5.661343→1.980066→0.805819; short-run rejection cannot prove its eventual converged quality.

specific_early_forecast_risks.topic: higher LR gives a speed/geometry/coverage trade-off
specific_early_forecast_risks.text: lr1e3 at768 has speed0.241740,36.01% lower than the joint anchor, but length/width are43.01%/81.77% higher, collision57.57% higher and onroad2.2640pp lower. Versus new_control its length/width are22.41%/15.05% lower, demonstrating that the reference matters. Primary onroad drop2.1201pp exceeds the2pp allowance by0.1201pp. Its gate passed at512 and fails at768; the sole seed/cell does not establish statistical significance.

The14-trial phase1 gate-eligible winner is speed4 at128, heading_p0 at256, shape_p2 at512. shape_p2 fails the onroad gate at128 and length gate at256, yet wins at512; a256-only pruning rule would discard this later winner. heading_p0 wins at256 but fails the speed gate at512.

At512 shape_p2 R0.815705 beats joint anchor0.858129; at768 joint anchor0.880956 beats shape_p2 0.892906. clip2 narrowly beats the joint anchor at512 (0.855659 versus0.858129) and trails it at768 (0.911863 versus0.880956). These flips include the same TRAIN817/GEN2817/eval1024; they are not changes of test membership.

specific_early_forecast_risks.topic: absolute learning and relative rank can diverge
specific_early_forecast_risks.text: shape_p2 collision changes2.087629→2.169702 (+3.93%), while new_control improves2.825442→1.920581 (-32.03%); its collision/control ratio flips0.73887→1.12971. speed4 speed improves0.517224→0.389110 but its speed/control ratio worsens0.73291→0.84598 because control improves faster. Do not extrapolate early fractional advantages as constant.

suggested_report_sentence: 短期结果能筛查学习速度与指标取舍，不能稳定预测最终排名：128/256/512的最优候选发生变化，512→768也出现shape/联合loss与clip/联合loss的排名翻转；当前仅TRAIN817、GEN2817、1024场景，应以更长从头训练及冻结候选后的1817/2817确认验证，而不将单点优势视为最终最优。
limitations: Only lr2e4/lr1e3/clip2 are complete phase2 arms in this frozen snapshot; all other interventions remain outside this review.
768 comparison of phase1 recipes only contains carried-forward survivors plus the new joint recipe; not all14 recipes were extended, so it cannot identify the global768 winner of allphase1 trials.
No confidence intervals or final-convergence forecast are supported by oneTRAIN and oneGEN cell.
Search1024 and milestones were adaptively inspected; independent confirmation remains necessary.
LR interventions can affect optimization and EMA lag; these results do not isolate a causal explanation of the lag or prove final convergence order.
